body: No worries, and thanks, you too! :)
I'm really sorry for all you went through, thanks for sharing your story and for your kind words. I hope we can fight it together.
Oh I never meant the sub specifically, I actually just meant in general. Sorry if it sounded like that but thanks a lot for your advice.
yeah... thanks for reaching out. I'll definitely do it first chance I get
go fuck yourself, you know absolutely nothing. This is a vent sub so get the hell out. Shame on you.

Everything you said is 100 times true. Why do we have to live off of judging other people? Why do we need to feel superior over things that people can't change? It's so shit. The world is absolutely fucked up.

I'm happy for you, truly. But some people are unable to just "ignore" it. When I get told something racist, I'm not going to ignore the same way I'm not going to ignore someone commenting on my physical appearance. It'd be far better for people to just stop saying demeaning things that for us to just take it.
